limitations: These observations cover the development matrix checker; they do not establish the 117 displayed capabilities or full AUG-013 acceptance.
Cancellation uses the actual reader with an AbortSignal. Deadline testing advances a monotonic test clock after a real file read; no hard OS-read interruption is claimed.
Unsupported-platform testing supplies a refused host identifier; it does not qualify another OS.
External execution and reviewer identity remain self-reported; retained GitHub logs and checks are separately inspectable.

caseEvidence.success: actual expansion identities and reciprocal graph remain complete without acceptance credit
caseEvidence.permission_denied: outside-root evidence and ambiguous paths are denied without exposing outside bytes
caseEvidence.cancelled: pre-abort and cancellation after a real read stop further reads
caseEvidence.deadline: deadline expires around actual file I/O without fabricating a scenario result
caseEvidence.unsupported_platform: unsupported host is rejected before reading and malformed limits are rejected

hosted.skipScope: 12 existing Windows-only tests; all matrix cases passed
